title: Research Perspective Note
description: One independent perspective worker's compressed contribution to a deep_research run. It is a research memo slice, not raw notes.

finding_summary.description: Compressed research judgment. Mid-pipeline text length is not capped; grounding and final director rendering remain separately gated.

specialized_angle.description: Optional (2026-08-07). The assigned angle specialized to THIS topic in one sentence: what a real specialist holding this angle would care about that a generalist would not — the term they would use, the failure they would expect, the evidence they would demand. The generic label is a starting point; researching the label instead of the specialization is how four perspectives collapse into one.

expected_disagreement.description: Optional (2026-08-07). One point on which this perspective expects another panel member to disagree substantively, and why it holds its position anyway. Agreement between perspectives is cheap; recorded tension is what makes the synthesis worth reading.

blind_spot.description: Optional (2026-08-07). What this angle structurally CANNOT see, declared so the synthesizer compensates for it instead of inheriting it.
